---
title: ""
page-layout: custom
toc: false
body-classes: retro-desktop-body
listing:
  - id: posts-listing
    contents: "posts/*/*.qmd"
    sort: "date desc"
    max-items: 3
    date-format: "YYYY-MM-DD"
    template: assets/recent-posts.ejs
    fields: [title, date, categories, path]
  - id: pubs-listing
    contents: "publications/papers.yml"
    sort: "date desc"
    max-items: 4
    date-format: "YYYY"
    template: assets/recent-pubs.ejs
    fields: [title, date, description, path]
  - id: projects-listing
    contents: "projects/*/index.qmd"
    sort: "date desc"
    max-items: 4
    template: assets/recent-projects.ejs
    fields: [title, description, categories, path]
---

<script>
  // Relógio da barra de tarefas
  function updateClock() {
    const now = new Date();
    const h = String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, '0');
    const m = String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0');
    document.getElementById('taskbar-clock').textContent = h + ':' + m;
  }
  updateClock();
  setInterval(updateClock, 30000);
</script>
